raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The bar chart presents the accuracy percentages of different educational methods across three subjects: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, while the horizontal axis lists the three subjects. Each subject has six bars corresponding to six different methods: DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO. The bars are color-coded and patterned to distinguish between the methods. The accuracy percentages vary across subjects and methods, with some methods showing higher accuracy in certain subjects. The chart does not include any additional annotations or visual elements that indicate trends or comparisons beyond the raw accuracy percentages.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: The bar chart displays the accuracy percentages of different methods across three subjects: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, while the horizontal axis lists the subjects. Each method is represented by a unique color and pattern: DAPO+Self-reflection (blue), DAPO (orange), GRPO (green), SRPO (light blue), PPO+Self-reflection (dark green), and PPO (grey). The chart shows that PPO+Self-reflection generally has the highest accuracy, particularly in Physics, where it reaches just above 60%. DAPO+Self-reflection also performs well, especially in MMLU and Mathverse. The other methods show varying levels of accuracy, with some performing better in certain subjects than others. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting order for the methods, and no particular method is visually emphasized.
